title: Second Chance Flame
style: Dark Memphis phonk with 140 BPM, single-motif percussion, distorted 808 slides, chopped cowbell, punchy kick, lo-fi vinyl crackle, murky dark pads, bilingual rap delivery, raw underground tape grit, minimal hook, male vocals, rap, raw, pop, minimal, lo-fi
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Rafa was hungry for more
Wanted his art at one hundred
Corey’s family reached out
Gave him a hand, gave him cover

A second chance in his chest
He stepped back in with the spark
Where I feel like a dreamer
And I rise out of the dark

[Chorus]
Rafa and Corey
Rafa and Corey
We move like one team

A second chance
A second chance
We came back new

I feel like a dreamer
I feel like a dreamer
And I rise like a phoenix

Together, as a team
Together, as a team
We make it through

[Verse 2]
Rafa found his voice again
Every scar turned into gold
Corey kept the lane open
When the night was getting cold

No more doubt on his shoulders
No more fear in the frame
He put his heart in motion
And he came back in the game

[Pre-Chorus]
One hand pulled him higher
One family lit the way
Now the pain is fuel
And the past can’t stay

[Chorus]
Rafa and Corey
Rafa and Corey
We move like one team

A second chance
A second chance
We came back new

I feel like a dreamer
I feel like a dreamer
And I rise like a phoenix

Together, as a team
Together, as a team
We make it through

[Bridge]
From the dust to the flame
From the loss to the pride
He was built for this moment
With the whole crew by his side

[Chorus]
Rafa and Corey
Rafa and Corey
We move like one team

A second chance
A second chance
We came back new

I feel like a dreamer
I feel like a dreamer
And I rise like a phoenix

Together, as a team
Together, as a team
We make it through
